items.title: Satellite images show Venezuelan earthquakes wiped out entire towns
items.description: Venezuela's devastating earthquakes flattened buildings and coated parts of the northern coast in dust and debris, satellite imagery shows.

items.title: Thai teen's ashes laid to rest by family after alleged murder
items.description: The family of a Thai teenager allegedly killed by an Australian man has placed her cremated ashes to rest at a local Buddhist temple as they seek justice for her murder.

items.title: Cashback delays frustrate electric vehicle owners
items.description: When Mustansir Milky took the leap and bought a new electric vehicle, he didn't expect to have to fight to get the $5,000 cashback payment he was promised.

items.title: Concerns grow over heading the ball in football
items.description: With all eyes on the World Cup, Australian football's management of the risks associated with the practice of heading the ball, such as dementia and CTE, is in the spotlight.

items.title: Polling whets Labor's appetite for reform
items.description: The slight recovery in Labor's polling shifts assumptions about what's in store for the remainder of this parliamentary term.

items.title: Australians caught between homelessness and the law
items.description: For Australians on the brink of homelessness, dilapidated boats have become a way to stave off sleeping on the streets, but many are being removed from these vessels amid a safety crackdown.

items.title: Live: Kane double act saves England after massive scare against DR Congo
items.description: Harry Kane strikes twice after half time as the Three Lions fight back to defeat DR Congo 2-1 and progress to the Round of 16. Follow live.

items.title: The state with the highest interest burden may surprise you
items.description: Who had it tougher on housing? These stats may put the generational debate to bed.

items.title: Pat Conroy to announce defence shake-up aimed at cost blowouts
items.description: Defence Industry Minister Pat Conroy is set to appeal to the Labor faithful to get behind AUKUS as he announces a defence shake-up targeting wasteful spending.

items.title: Election review a 'hyper-partisan witch-hunt', Coalition says
items.description: A Coalition group has launched an extraordinary attack on one of parliament's top committees, slamming its election inquiry as biased.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
